Docs fixture map (doc-and-spec-indexing, task 1.2)
==================================================

Not indexed (.txt is unsupported), so it does not change any counts.

Path rules: index paths keep the build root as a prefix
(e.g. tests/fixtures/docs/src/audit/log.rs when built with root
tests/fixtures/docs). Plain and qualified paths in docs are written
relative to the index root (src/audit/log.rs); Markdown links are
relative to the document's own directory (../src/audit/log.rs).
Resolution in task 4.2 must handle both.

Names used here must not collide with the other fixtures' asserted
names (User, Greeter, Calculator, global_function, ...).

Code tree (src/)
----------------
src/audit/log.rs        struct AuditLog; impl AuditLog { new (l7), append (l11-13) };
                        rotate_segments (unique bare name); verify_chain.
                        Line 1 is a doc comment outside any symbol.
src/audit/retention.rs  struct RetentionPolicy; impl RetentionPolicy { new, apply };
                        flush_buffer (duplicate bare name, also in invoice.py).
src/billing/invoice.py  class InvoiceService { issue, run }; class RetentionPolicy
                        { apply } (makes RetentionPolicy::apply ambiguous);
                        flush_buffer.

docs/guide.md  (tasks 2.1, 2.2, 2.5)
-------------
- Text before the first heading.
- h1 -> h2 -> h3 -> h4 nesting; "Skipped From H1" is an h3 under an h1.
- Duplicate anchors: Usage, Usage, Usage 1, Usage
  -> usage, usage-1, usage-1-1, usage-2 (github-slugger behaviour).
- Punctuation/inline code/emoji heading
  "Step 2: Configure `AuditLog` (fast!) 🚀" -> step-2-configure-auditlog-fast-
- Non-ASCII heading "Überblick & Café" -> überblick--café
- Setext h2 "Setext Heading Level Two".
- "# Not A Heading" inside fenced code is not a section.
- Terms: Casting Director, Audit Service (also as link text), Compliance
  Officer (after stripping "The"), bold "ledger"; "This Week" reduces to one
  word and is dropped; "Release Manager" occurs once and is dropped; a
  6-word capitalised run appears twice (dropped, not split: 2.5); a
  5-word bold span is ignored; terms in headings, inline code and fenced
  code do not count.

docs/links.md  (tasks 2.4, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4)
-------------
- Mention before the first heading (decision recorded in 2.4).
- Rule 1 Markdown links: relative + fragment (linked), doc-to-doc link
  (linked to guide.md), external https / mailto / pure #anchor (ignored),
  leaving the index root (unresolved), missing target (unresolved).
- Rule 2 paths: plain, './' prefixed (linked), missing (unresolved).
- Rule 3: src/audit/log.rs::append (linked to append), src/audit/log.rs:12
  (innermost symbol append), src/audit/log.rs:1 (falls back to the file).
- Rule 4: AuditLog::append and AuditLog.new (linked via impl range);
  RetentionPolicy::apply (ambiguous: Rust and Python).
- Rule 5: rotate_segments (linked), flush_buffer (ambiguous), new
  (denylisted), run (under 4 chars), does_not_exist (unresolved).
- Fenced code: AuditLog::new, verify_chain, src/audit/retention.rs.
- Deepest-section attribution: mentions under "### Paths" belong to that
  h3 only, never to "## Code Spans" or "# Link Coverage".

docs/adr/  (tasks 2.3, 5.x user stories)
----------
004-immutable-audit-log.md  every recognised key; tags as a list;
                            supersedes as a scalar; an unknown key (owner);
                            quoted date. Mentions AuditLog::append and
                            src/audit/log.rs::append (user story 3).
005-retention.md            numeric id; YAML-typed date; tags as a scalar;
                            supersedes as a list; a later '---' thematic
                            break that is not frontmatter.
006-malformed.md            malformed frontmatter: no DocMeta, sections
                            still indexed.

api/ and config/  (tasks 3.1, 3.2, 3.3)
----------------
api/openapi.yaml        OpenAPI 3 by name: GET/POST /entries, GET
                        /entries/{id}; non-method keys (parameters, $ref)
                        ignored; schemas AuditEntry, AuditPage.
api/swagger.json        Swagger 2 by name: GET/PUT /invoices (PUT has no
                        operationId), DELETE /invoices/{id}; definitions
                        Invoice.
api/billing-api.yml     detected by content: BOM + comments before a
                        top-level openapi key; PATCH and TRACE operations.
api/empty-openapi.json  detected by content, no paths: zero operations.
config/settings.yaml    nested openapi key: NOT OpenAPI; keeps its generic
                        YAML symbols.
>1 MB JSON              generated at test runtime in a tempdir (3.1);
                        never committed.

Snapshot for 3.3 (0.2.0 output, generic YAML extraction)
--------------------------------------------------------
config/settings.yaml symbols (name kind line): openapi config 1, service
config 2, name config 3, 3.0.0 kafka_topic 4, database config 5, url
config 6 (re-checked against the 0.2.0 binary in 3.3). 3.3 must leave this
unchanged. Note: the 0.2.0 YAML extractor locates keys by first text
match, so some lines are wrong (openapi at line 1 matches the comment).
Version strings like 3.0.0 also pass the Kafka topic heuristic. Both are
existing bugs, out of scope for this feature. 0.2.0 also gave openapi.yaml
21 generic symbols and 2 such topics; 3.3 removes them.
